beats.say: For the first time ever, the Ballon d'Or is coming to London.
According to BBC Sport, the 2026 ceremony takes place at London's Palladium Theatre on Monday 26 October at 20:00 GMT.
BBC Sport notes the prize has been run by France Football magazine since 1956, celebrating its 70th year.
So how do you actually decide the best footballer in the world?
BBC Sport explains that a dual voting system determines the winners for football's pinnacle individual prize.
And Harry Kane arrives after scoring 73 goals across club and international competitions in the 2025 26 season.
Monday night, one player lifts the trophy. Who gets your vote?

facts: The 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony will take place at 20:00 GMT on Monday, 26 October, at London's Palladium Theatre.
It is the first time the Ballon d'Or event will be held in London.
Back for its 70th year, the Ballon d'Or ceremony will once again recognise the best footballing talent in the world.
Run by France Football magazine since 1956, it is widely viewed as the pinnacle of individual prizes for professional footballers worldwide.
A dual voting system is used to determine Ballon d'Or winners.
Harry Kane scored 73 goals across club and international competitions in the 2025 26 season.

es.title: El Ballon d'Or llega a Londres por primera vez 🏆
es.summary: La ceremonia del Ballon d'Or de 2026 será en el Palladium Theatre de Londres el lunes 26 de octubre. BBC Sport informa que es la primera vez que el evento se realiza en Londres, con Harry Kane marcando 73 goles en la temporada 2025-26.

pt.title: O Ballon d'Or vem para Londres pela primeira vez 🏆
pt.summary: A cerimônia do Ballon d'Or de 2026 será no Palladium Theatre em Londres na segunda-feira 26 de outubro. A BBC Sport informa que é a primeira vez que o evento é realizado em Londres, com Harry Kane marcando 73 gols na temporada 2025-26.

hi.title: Ballon d'Or पहली बार लंदन आ रहा है 🏆
hi.summary: 2026 का Ballon d'Or समारोह सोमवार 26 अक्टूबर को लंदन के पैलेडियम थिएटर में है। BBC Sport की रिपोर्ट है कि यह पहली बार है जब यह कार्यक्रम लंदन में आयोजित किया जा रहा है, जिसमें Harry Kane ने 2025-26 सीज़न में 73 गोल किए।
